efficio_component_type.description: Identifies this shape as a text component.

efficio_text_format.description: How the generated text content should be structured.

ai.purpose: Selects the structural format of generated text.

enum_descriptions.plain: A single run of plain text.

efficio_sizing_mode.description: Whether text sizing limits are inferred automatically or set manually.

efficio_max_chars.description: Maximum total characters — a strict content limit. Set by the author, entered manually, or populated by the editor's auto sizing estimate.

ai.purpose: Strict limit on the total number of characters the generated text may use. The generated content must never exceed it; shorten or compact the text until it fits.

efficio_target_chars.description: Preferred (target) total characters the generated text should aim for; optional sizing guidance, not a maximum. When present it must not exceed efficio_max_chars.

ai.purpose: The preferred (target) total character count for the whole generated text — aim for approximately this length. Guidance only, not a hard bound: the strict limits are max_chars, the min/max item count, and the min/max characters per item. Stay near target_chars while always fitting within those limits.

efficio_min_items.description: Minimum number of items (strings in the text's items array) — a strict lower bound. Authored, entered manually, or populated by the editor's auto sizing estimate.

ai.purpose: Strict minimum number of items (strings in items[]) the generated text must include. Produce at least this many items; never fewer.

efficio_target_items.description: Preferred (target) number of items (strings in the text's items array); optional sizing guidance, not a bound. When present it must be within efficio_min_items and efficio_max_items. Not applicable to plain text, which is always a single item.

ai.purpose: The preferred (target) number of items (strings in items[]) — aim for approximately this many items. Guidance only, not a hard bound: the strict limits are the min/max item count and the per-item character limits. Stay near target_items while always fitting within the min and max item count. Not applicable to plain text, which is always exactly one item.

efficio_max_items.description: Maximum number of items (strings in the text's items array) — a strict content limit. Authored, entered manually, or populated by the editor's auto sizing estimate.

ai.purpose: Strict maximum number of items (strings in items[]) the generated text may include. The content must never exceed it; shorten or compact it (use fewer items) until it fits.

efficio_min_chars_per_item.description: Minimum characters per item (per string in items[]) — a strict lower bound. Authored, entered manually, or populated by the editor's auto sizing estimate.

ai.purpose: Strict minimum number of characters for each item (each string in items[]). Every item must be at least this long.

efficio_max_chars_per_item.description: Maximum characters per item (per string in items[]) — a strict content limit. Authored, entered manually, or populated by the editor's auto sizing estimate.

ai.purpose: Strict maximum number of characters for any single item (string in items[]). Each item must never exceed it; shorten or compact each item until it fits.

efficio_target_chars_per_item.description: Preferred (target) characters per item; optional sizing guidance, not a maximum. When present it must be within min_chars_per_item and max_chars_per_item.

ai.purpose: The preferred (target) character count for each item (string in items[]) — aim for approximately this length per item. Guidance only, not a hard bound: stay within the strict min_chars_per_item and max_chars_per_item.

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Generate a concise executive slide title.
